context.transcript:
Good evening!
I'm so glad you all could make it tonight to celebrate our company's expansion.
When I first started this greeting card company, it was only a small team of three people struggling to make our business work.
And now we have 20 full-time employees, we've expanded our distribution, and we even have a new, much larger office space.
So please, before you leave the banquet, pick up your gift bag.
It's my personal token of appreciation to thank all of you for your contribution to our company's success.
context.transcript_translation:
大家晚上好！
我很高兴今晚能邀请到各位来庆祝我们公司的扩张。
当我刚创立这家贺卡公司时，只有三个人组成的微小团队，努力让我们的生意运转起来。
而现在我们有 20 名全职员工，扩大了分销范围，甚至还有一个新的、更大的办公空间。
所以请各位在离开宴会前，领取您的伴手礼袋。
这是我个人的一点心意，感谢大家对公司成功的贡献。
